revised_request.note: Separate hypothetical lower-price request. Supported income, available cash, debts and non-tax costs stay unchanged. This is not a price forecast or a real property change.

open_evidence.needed: Independently verify actual income, employment, history and the treatment of variable pay.
Authenticate account histories, source of funds, restrictions and availability before closing.
Obtain an authorized credit review and reconcile all actual recurring obligations.
Verify agreement, valuation, actual taxes, heating and condo costs for the subject property.
Verify the actual rate commitment, eligibility, insurance, tax relief and applicable lending criteria.
A qualified reviewer must document their actual review; this synthetic exercise supplies no signature or approval.
